sloka: असौ च जीमूतनिकाशरूपः कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः ।समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतुर्विस्फारयन् भाति धनुर्विधून्वन् ।। ६.५९.२० ।।।।
transliteration: asau ca jīmūtanikāśarūpaḥ kumbhaḥ pṛthuvyūḍhasujātavakṣāḥ ।samāhitaḥ pannagarājaketurvisphārayan bhāti dhanurvidhūnvan ।। 6.59.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."
